name: Campfire Smolder
description: Always-on campfire (smolder): a smouldering campfire: low small flames under a thick, dark column of smoke, a few embers and a dim light.

attachment.notes: Attach the `fire_pit` node at the centre of the fire pit on the ground (y = 0); the effect draws no logs, stones or pit. The five Campfire states share every node id and control, so a game can switch or blend them. Feed the global wind into Wind strength (0 calm, 1 light, 3 strong) and Wind direction (degrees around Y). It is always on and loops seamlessly.
